summary.text: Holly Sargent is a Democratic member of the Maine House of Representatives for District 147 and is a candidate for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Sargent has represented District 147 since 2022 and is a Harvard graduate who founded two companies.

paragraphs.text: Holly Sargent lives in York, Maine, graduated from Windham High School, and earned a B.A. from Harvard University.

Her career experience includes founding Doing Good While Doing Well and serving as its CEO, founding HTSargent LLC and serving as its president, and working as executive director of development at The Rhodes Trust.
She founded the Harvard Women's Leadership Board and has been affiliated with the International Women's Forum.
Sargent won District 147 in 2022, defeating David Koopman, and won re-election in 2024.
Ballotpedia lists her 2023-2024 committee assignment as the Education and Cultural Affairs Committee.
